title: Differential-Linear Distinguisher Bounds for 10-Round Serpent
summary: Extensive searches found no qualifying distinguisher for 10-round Serpent above two to the minus sixty-four bias; establishing lower bounds and deciding existence remain open.

formal_statement.body: Establish lower bounds for differential--linear distinguishers to support evaluation of cipher security against differential--linear cryptanalysis, and resolve the concrete case of 10-round Serpent by determining whether any differential--linear distinguisher has bias greater than $2^{-64}$. Extensive search efforts have not found such a distinguisher, but its existence remains uncertain.

scope.domain: Differential-linear cryptanalysis of block ciphers, centered on the concrete target of 10-round Serpent.
parameters: Round count: 10, fixing the concrete Serpent target
Bias threshold: $2^{-64}$, setting the cutoff in the existence question
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish lower bounds for differential-linear distinguishers and determine whether any distinguisher against 10-round Serpent has bias greater than $2^{-64}$.

citations.label: Enhancing the DATF Technique in Differential-Linear Cryptanalysis

progress.summary: The source presents lower-bound computation as important for security evaluation and isolates the 10-round Serpent existence question at the stated bias threshold. It reports extensive unsuccessful searches, not a proof of nonexistence.
citation_labels: Cheng Che et al., Enhancing the DATF Technique in Differential-Linear Cryptanalysis
